items.rationale: Fixed, permanently wired AC is a building component (4.2.2); surge damage is insured under the lightning-overvoltage peril (2.3.3) if lightning caused it, which the description does not state. Like-for-like replacement is indemnified at the customary upper price per the references, about 1413.
Labour to put the replaced unit in place is an ancillary charge that follows its principal item (7.1.11). It is indemnified at the reference level of about 480 if the unit is covered.
An equivalent stand replacing the pre-existing scorched console is reinstatement, not new equipment (1.3, 7.1.9). Reference level about 61.
Freight is an ancillary charge following the covered replacement units (7.1.11). Reference level about 43.
